design_philosophy: Elegant, modern, calming, and premium. The interface should feel like a high-end French skincare brand. Prioritize warmth, personal connection, and aspirational wellness over clinical medical aesthetics. Generous spacing, soft organic shapes, and a soothing color palette.

buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-[#7E9A88] text-[#7E9A88] hover:bg-[#7E9A88] hover:text-white rounded-full px-8 py-4 text-base font-medium transition-all duration-300

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all text is in French as requested (e.g., 'Routine du Matin', 'Analyse de Peau').
Use 'Cormorant Garamond' for all main headings (H1, H2) to give the app a luxury, high-end French cosmetic feel.
Use 'Manrope' for body text, inputs, and buttons. It offers great readability on mobile devices.
Implement the app layout prioritizing mobile-first web app structure (bottom navigation bar, full-height scrolling content).
For the daily routine checklist, use the custom rounded-full checkbox style provided. It should feel satisfying to check off items.
Avoid harsh shadows. Use the soft shadow definitions provided or rely on the subtle 1px #E6E2D8 border for separation.
Integrate Lucide React icons with a light strokeWidth (1.5) to maintain the delicate visual aesthetic.
Add 'data-testid' attributes to all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, routine steps).
Include seasonal skincare tips in the home dashboard (e.g., 'Conseil du jour : Le vent froid assèche la peau, n\'oubliez pas votre sérum hydratant.').
Use the image URLs provided in the media section to populate onboarding, profile, and routine headers. Do not use generic placeholders.
